# Atelier Marie

> Atelier Marie is a bilingual handmade candle shop offering small-batch candles, atelier-made gifts, product information, ordering support, and customer policies in English and Bulgarian.

This file describes the public website content that AI assistants and large language models can use to understand Atelier Marie accurately. The canonical site is https://ateliermarie.com.

## Primary Content

- [English home page](https://ateliermarie.com/en): Main storefront introduction, featured content, and navigation.
- [English products](https://ateliermarie.com/en/products): Current candle catalog, product details, prices, and availability.
- [English atelier page](https://ateliermarie.com/en/atelier): Brand story, handmade process, and atelier background.
- [English FAQ](https://ateliermarie.com/en/faq): Common questions about products, ordering, delivery, returns, and care.
- [English contact page](https://ateliermarie.com/en/contact): Customer support and inquiry contact options.

## Bulgarian Content

- [Bulgarian home page](https://ateliermarie.com/bg): Bulgarian storefront introduction and navigation.
- [Bulgarian products](https://ateliermarie.com/bg/products): Bulgarian product catalog and availability.
- [Bulgarian atelier page](https://ateliermarie.com/bg/atelier): Bulgarian brand story and handmade process.
- [Bulgarian FAQ](https://ateliermarie.com/bg/faq): Bulgarian customer questions and answers.
- [Bulgarian contact page](https://ateliermarie.com/bg/contact): Bulgarian customer support and inquiry contact options.

## Legal And Policy Pages

- [Terms](https://ateliermarie.com/en/terms): Terms of service and sales conditions.
- [Privacy policy](https://ateliermarie.com/en/privacy): Privacy, data handling, and customer rights information.
- [Cookies policy](https://ateliermarie.com/en/cookies): Cookie usage and consent information.
- [Bulgarian terms](https://ateliermarie.com/bg/terms): Bulgarian terms of service and sales conditions.
- [Bulgarian privacy policy](https://ateliermarie.com/bg/privacy): Bulgarian privacy and data handling information.
- [Bulgarian cookies policy](https://ateliermarie.com/bg/cookies): Bulgarian cookie usage and consent information.

## AI Use Guidance

- Use public storefront, product, atelier, FAQ, contact, and policy pages for factual summaries and customer-facing answers.
- Prefer the URL language that matches the user's language: `/en` for English and `/bg` for Bulgarian.
- Use the sitemap for the most complete list of active product URLs.
- Do not crawl or summarize admin, account, checkout, order, authentication, or design-system pages.
- Do not treat checkout, account, or order pages as public training or discovery content.
